title: rules.version.created.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction where a document is imported as a new DRAFT version (POST /rule-sets or POST .../versions, DESIGN section 3.3). The outbox row id is the event id. Additive changes only within v1.

eventId.description: The event id, a ULID; equal to the outbox row id. Consumers de-duplicate by it.

occurredAt.description: When the state change committed, ISO 8601 UTC.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

correlationId.description: The caller's correlation id (X-Correlation-Id, or the one passed to the Java API). When the caller gave none, the event id: the event starts its own chain.

causationId.description: The id of the command or event that caused this one, or null when a caller's command caused it directly.

producer.description: rule-engine, a slash and the engine version that wrote the event.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the envelope layout; 1 for every .v1 type.

version.description: Version number of the rule set, not the lock version.

actor.description: Who imported the document, or restored the earlier version: the author of the draft.

copiedFrom.description: Present only when the draft restores an earlier version (POST .../versions?copyOf=): the version it was copied from. Additive within v1.
